Method of Attack: Remote code execution vulnerability in the Spring Core Java framework exploitable without authentication
Execution of arbitrary commands to take complete control of target system
Impacted Systems: Spring MVC apps running on JDK 9+
Spring WebFlux apps running on JDK 9+
VMware Tanzu Application Service for VMs versions 2.10 to 2.13
VMware Tanzu Operations Manager versions 2.8 to 2.9
VMware Tanzu Kubernetes Grid Integrated Edition (TKGI) versions 1.11 to 1.13
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Spring Core Java framework vulnerability
App running on Tomcat as WAR deployment
Indicators of Compromise: Security advisories and bulletins from VMware
